name: @tranzfer/infra
description: Cloudflare infrastructure for Tranzfer, defined in Alchemy.

scripts.plan:production: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://tranzfer.app node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js plan --stage production
scripts.deploy:production: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://tranzfer.app node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy --stage production
scripts.plan:staging: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://staging.tranzfer.app node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js plan --stage staging
scripts.deploy:staging: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://staging.tranzfer.app node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy --yes --stage staging
scripts.destroy:preview: case "$ALCHEMY_STAGE" in pr-[0-9]*) ;; *) echo "destroy:preview destroys only pr-<n> stages, not '$ALCHEMY_STAGE'" >&2; exit 1;; esac && env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://$ALCHEMY_STAGE.tranzfer.app node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js destroy --yes
